faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by District Court Kadegaon to fill available vacancies for eligible candidates seeking temporary government employment opportunities in the region.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for District Court Kadegaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification is Part-Time Sweeper on a daily wage basis as per the official guidelines.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in District Court Kadegaon Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Part-Time Sweeper post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for District Court Kadegaon jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled applications through postal services to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for District Court Kadegaon Part-Time Sweeper Recruitment is 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Part-Time Sweeper post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Part-Time Sweeper position must fulfill the requirement of being a local resident as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or pay scale for District Court Kadegaon Part-Time Sweeper?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Part-Time Sweeper position will receive remuneration as per the Minimum Wages Act.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the offline application form for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Interested local individuals should send their application in a sealed envelope to the Civil Judge Junior Division, Kadegaon by the specified last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Part-Time Sweeper post offered by District Court Kadegaon is temporary, operating on a daily wage basis.
